items.title: Is AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) Undervalued As AT&T Tests Direct To Device Satellite Handoff?
items.summary: AT&T’s recent test with AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) produced what it calls the first successful handoff between a terrestrial cellular network and a direct to device satellite connection using standard smartphones. For investors watching AST SpaceMobile, the story right now is sharp volatility. The share price has dropped 15.22% over the last day and 52.15% over the past month, even as the 3 year total shareholder return of 631.23% points to a very large move over a longer horizon.
